# Maestro 1.1.3
some initial all-around perf improvements for maestro + small QoL and bug fixes
- [MAE-188: corrupted conversation](https://linear.app/maestro-will-dominate/issue/MAE-188/corrupted-conversation) - [MAE-185: window moving when it should be resizing](https://linear.app/maestro-will-dominate/issue/MAE-185/window-moving-when-it-should-be-resizing) - [MAE-167: make it so tabs inside hidden groups do not get counted for Option+Number navigation](https://linear.app/maestro-will-dominate/issue/MAE-167/make-it-so-tabs-inside-hidden-groups-do-not-get-counted-for) - [MAE-184: new terminal being ready instantly](https://linear.app/maestro-will-dominate/issue/MAE-184/new-terminal-being-ready-instantly) - [MAE-131: "Image not available"](https://linear.app/maestro-will-dominate/issue/MAE-131/image-not-available) - [MAE-183: auto focus on input on maestro main window focus](https://linear.app/maestro-will-dominate/issue/MAE-183/auto-focus-on-input-on-maestro-main-window-focus)
